knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r include=FALSE}
require(tidyverse)
require(tigerstats)
davisdata <- read.csv(file="UCDavis.csv")
```
Our Goal is to answer this question Is there a difference between the alcohol consumed between the row
 you choose to sit in??

# Introduction
the question is; is there a relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink?
data from UCDavis   
$H_0$ There is no difference in relationship where you sit in class and how much you drink.   
$H_A$ There is a difference between where you sit in class and how much you drink   

# Methods
seat is categorical  
Alcohol is numerical  

# data summaries 



## Now add in boxplot

```{r}
boxplot(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)

```


students in the back tend to consume more ounces per week then front and middle  

## Numerical Summaries 

```{r}
favstats(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
```

numerical summary shows that the students who sit in the back are consuming 5 times more than alcohol than those in the middle and front row.

## Inferential Tests
```{r}
model1 <- aov(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
summary.aov(model1)
```

the P value is 0.000116, we fail to reject the null hypothesis because the value is lower than 0.05  
and conclude that there is relationship between where someone sits and how much someone drinks
